description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be discontinued.

description.zh: 数据迁移实例ID，可以通过调用**DescribeMigrationJobs**接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the data migration instance. You can call the **DescribeMigrationJobs** operation to query the instance ID.

description.zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts delete-migration-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --migration-job-id dtsyiwe9b0gp2p0000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
